To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the natural gas plant value is sensitive to the gas price and the electricity price, the optimal control strategies are dependent on the gas price, the electricity price and the temperature of the boiler, the optimal control surface is concave in gas price and electricity price, and the optimal control surface has a discontinuity in the temperature of the plant boiler.
the optimal control strategies and contract value of the natural gas power plant are sensitive to the regime-switching and the dependence structure.
The value of a natural gas-fired power plant is affected by the electricity price, gas price, boiler temperature and time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a stochastic control problem of a natural gas-fired power plant.
a stochastic control problem which is motivated by the valuation of a power plant under the Levy regime-switching and copula dependence models.
the valuation of a power plant in the presence of Levy copulas and regime switching, which is a new approach in this field.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method is capable of modelling the dependence risk of energy prices, and the value of the gas-fired power station can be obtained with a high degree of accuracy.
a gas-fired power plant is more profitable in the long term when compared with a coal-fired one.

our approach is capable of capturing all the important features of the problem under study, and it provides a good tool for the valuation and optimisation of power plants under the regime-switching Levy copula model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we develop a stochastic control model to optimise the operation of a natural gas-fired power plant while taking into account the dependence between the gas and electricity spot prices.

the optimal strategy for operating the power station is to produce electricity when the gas and electricity spot prices are high, the temperature of the boiler is high, the electricity price is high, the gas price is high and the time to maturity is low.

the optimal operating strategy is to keep a constant temperature in the boiler when the price of natural gas is high and low and to increase or decrease the temperature of the boiler depending on the gas price if it is moderate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the plant value depends on the gas and the electricity prices and on the regime-switch.
the value of a gas-fired power plant is highly sensitive to the regime-switching parameters.
the value of the power plant is sensitive to changes in electricity and gas prices, and to the temperature of the boiler.
